record.content: Tilden has New Woodland (17-50), Wildcat View (17-75), and Gillespie (17-75) group camps with picnic tables, BBQ, fire ring, and chemical toilets; reservations are by phone at least three business days ahead. ES Anderson Equestrian Camp holds 4-50 people, requires at least five horses, has horse water by arrangement but no potable human water, and uses the same booking lead.
